title: Uxbridge Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent centres, water hazard notes, and shopping streets for Uxbridge.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 or 112 first.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Hillingdon Hospital: Pield Heath Road, Uxbridge UB8 3NN. From Uxbridge station: ~1.5 miles southeast via High Street, Hillingdon Road, and Kingston Lane (~25 min walk), or take bus U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, or U7 directly to Hillingdon Hospital (~10 min).
- Nearest Major Trauma Centre: St Mary's Hospital, Praed Street, London W2 1NY (access via A40 eastbound or Piccadilly/Metropolitan lines to central London).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres (UTC):
- Hillingdon Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Co-located on-site at Pield Heath Road, Uxbridge UB8 3NN.
- Mount Vernon Hospital Minor Injuries Unit: Rickmansworth Road, Northwood HA6 2RN. From Uxbridge station: ~5 miles northeast via A4020 and Rickmansworth Road, or take bus 331 or U9 towards Mount Vernon Hospital.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- The River Colne, Frays River, and Grand Union Canal run directly along the western boundary of Uxbridge; sustained downpours cause towpath and road flooding near High Street / Western Avenue (A40) bridges and surrounding riverbanks.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
Pharmacies and supermarkets situated on High Street Uxbridge, Windsor Street, and inside The Chimes / The Pavilions complexes can supply drinking water, emergency food, and basic medicines during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
